records.finding: Current Wikisource starts its ಜಾತಿಸ್ಮರಣ ಪದ್ದತಿ with the Pushpadatta verse. Independent blogs use a different global numbering/order, so source number must remain edition-specific.
Current Wikisource gives the Pushpadatta/Vararuchi verse as section item 2. Independent web transcriptions also show it as item 3 under a different sequence.
Current Wikisource item 3 begins the Akkamallamma narrative, while another online collection uses a different global sequence. This proves numbering cannot be treated as universal.
Current Wikisource item 4 is in the same biographical section. Historical/modern sources warn that the opening biographical poems may be interpolations or of uncertain authenticity.
Current Wikisource item 5 continues the opening biographical sequence. It should not be promoted to canonical until the historical edition is checked.
